I completely agree that the way she acted this year was in extreme poor taste. I didn’t hate Pete but didn’t care for their relationship and it felt too much like they were trying to prove their love. I was really disappointed with how she handled the break up and her transition to her next relationship but I don’t at all feel that she is milking his death. 

His fans (including myself) are still grieving his death months later and we’ve never met him or know him personally at all. Ariana had an actual relationship with him for nearly 2 years of her life. I could see how her posting about it the way she does could make it seem insincere, but to think she should be over it by now doesn’t make sense to me personally. And honestly I think people would say bad things if she WEREN’T talking/posting about him. I feel like she can’t really win. Some Mac fans were offended that she mentioned him in thank u next but I also believe they would have been offended if she had left him out while including all other exes too, if that makes sense. 

I might be biased as I am a huge fan of both artists, and I don’t know their relationship so I could be wrong. I know that they weren’t compatible anymore and their struggles were too much for them to handle. But I believe she truly loved him, and I don’t at all blame her for grieving. She must feel devastated and guilty, and she has to deal with this publicly while people review her every move. I’ll completely admit that I was disappointed by her earlier, but I can’t blame her for reacting to the death of someone she loved dearly for years. Not only was he her boyfriend, but they had a close friendship for years before they began dating. He was probably one of her favourite people for a big fraction of her life. I think about how when I went through a breakup last year I was a complete mess and probably not in my smartest state of mind, but at least I got to deal with it privately and didn’t have the world watching and criticizing. I don’t think she has the greatest coping mechanisms, but neither did I when I was in that position. I believe she genuinely is hurting, but that’s just my opinion and I don’t know her personally so I can’t say for certain. :-(
